# SpaFun

The goal of SpaFun is to …

## Installation

You can install the development version of SpaFun from
[GitHub](https://github.com/) with:

``` r

# install.packages("pak")
pak::pak("revalescente/SpaFun")
```

## Example

This is a basic example which shows you how to solve a common problem:

``` r

library(SpaFun)
## basic example code
```

What is special about using `README.Rmd` instead of just `README.md`?
You can include R chunks like so:

``` r

summary(cars)
#>      speed           dist       
#>  Min.   : 4.0   Min.   :  2.00  
#>  1st Qu.:12.0   1st Qu.: 26.00  
#>  Median :15.0   Median : 36.00  
#>  Mean   :15.4   Mean   : 42.98  
#>  3rd Qu.:19.0   3rd Qu.: 56.00  
#>  Max.   :25.0   Max.   :120.00
```

You’ll still need to render `README.Rmd` regularly, to keep `README.md`
up-to-date. `devtools::build_readme()` is handy for this.

You can also embed plots, for example:

![](reference/figures/README-pressure-1.png)

In that case, don’t forget to commit and push the resulting figure
files, so they display on GitHub and CRAN.

# Package index

## All functions

- [`ann2ppp()`](https://revalescente.github.io/SpaFun/reference/ann2ppp.md)
  : Read an h5ad file as a point pattern
- [`cells2ppp()`](https://revalescente.github.io/SpaFun/reference/cells2ppp.md)
  : Build a point pattern from a table of cells
- [`downsample()`](https://revalescente.github.io/SpaFun/reference/downsample.md)
  : Downsample a spatial point pattern
- [`downsample_KDE()`](https://revalescente.github.io/SpaFun/reference/downsample_KDE.md)
  : Inverse-density (KDE) downsampling
- [`downsample_uniform()`](https://revalescente.github.io/SpaFun/reference/downsample_uniform.md)
  : Uniform random downsampling
- [`downsample_window()`](https://revalescente.github.io/SpaFun/reference/downsample_window.md)
  : Downsampling by sub-windows
- [`fsmooth()`](https://revalescente.github.io/SpaFun/reference/fsmooth.md)
  : fsmooth Function to convert a vector of data points into a
  continuous functional object
- [`plot_smoothed_Lfun()`](https://revalescente.github.io/SpaFun/reference/plot_smoothed_Lfun.md)
  : plot_smoothed_Lfun Function to plot the smoothed Lcross object
- [`read_cells_h5ad()`](https://revalescente.github.io/SpaFun/reference/read_cells_h5ad.md)
  : Read cell centroids and labels from an h5ad file
- [`tcga_crops`](https://revalescente.github.io/SpaFun/reference/tcga_crops.md)
  : Example crops of five TCGA slides
